$comment: v2.1 -> v2.2 normalized component paths to a list of {match, rewrite} objects. Until v2.2 a file carried `path` as a plain string with a separate `rewrite-path`, and some carried the plural `paths`. One production file (regis-jnv, schema-version 2) still does. The nulls drop the array-only constraint of the newer schema before widening it - an RFC 7386 patch merges objects, it does not replace them.
